continuous_final_geometry_pathway.flow_policy: Choose C flow from actual upstream wetted cross-sections and safe original level, then seek consistent native Q. Current.6213 does not retroactively become an accepted target; .2994 remains a proposed single-branch design until measured matched.
continuous_final_geometry_pathway.upstream: Preserve full river and safe upstream/platform levels. Rebuild only branch attachment over real v3 channels using bed-clipped connected thick volumes, area*velocity balance, no global raise and no blanket full-width wetness requirement.
continuous_final_geometry_pathway.fall: One or more irregular thick continuous branches from upstream through actual rock gaps, gravity-consistent centerline, contact/subtraction operates on water rather than frozen rocks. Hybrid07a provides a static continuity precedent, not accepted appearance or transferable oldQ geometry.
continuous_final_geometry_pathway.source_to_native: Cut a transverse surface inside the prescribed source-volume region around z-5.35 after loop suitability is measured; retain native below and stitch authored branch to actual native closed contour with shared vertices and finite-thickness transition. No overlapping water planes or hidden caps; all-frame contour continuity required.
continuous_final_geometry_pathway.native_pool: Native impact and pool surface remain raw in the bulk. Initial stage must be physically compatible with selected flow and real downstream bed; current author-stage discontinuity or uniform scale correction is not accepted equilibrium.
continuous_final_geometry_pathway.Xplus: Investigate extension fromx8 tox14-16 along unchanged actual model until entire connected wet component terminates against a verified dry/solid cross-section. Existing sparse dry samples atx12/14 are not proof of a complete barrier. If not proven, no closed-dry or natural-outlet claim.
continuous_final_geometry_pathway.downstream: Place numerical outlets beyond a verified in-channel transition and real bed continuation. Join native surface to complete authored downstream water by shared contour vertices and a0.3-0.6m genuinely thick transition, with natural shoreline holes/bed contact; use an additional10-20cell native buffer beyond the displayed seam. Buffer alone does not prove pressure isolation.
continuous_final_geometry_pathway.unknown_submerged_geometry: Any necessary unmeasured bed extension is C, closed with real thickness, below measured/visible surfaces, and separately audited; no fake side walls to trap water against an actual open rock gap.
all_frame_checks: Every seam belongs to one connected closed manifold component; no internal duplicate caps or self-intersections
Actual rendered triangles tested for rock penetration, negative thickness and fixed-patch artifacts
Raw native bulk positions unchanged outside declared finite transition; report derived-versus-raw volume/area change
Shared seam coordinates/normals, upstream elevation safety, slope and actual Q consistency
Native foam/spray advects continuously, no white discs or opaque cover patches
HERO,FOOT,shore,outlets,upstream and orbit views expose all joins; no cropping-based pass
After bounded preview acceptance only, root may authorize sufficient warmup and actual10-second sequence; finite12/48frame tests do not prove it
